news.headline: RTW Investments/Roderick Wong file Schedule 13G/A reaffirming ~5.7% stake in uniQure
news.summary: Biotech-focused fund RTW Investments (with Dr. Roderick Wong) refiled its passive ownership disclosure showing roughly 3.9 million shares (~5.7%), signaling continued large specialist-investor positioning heading into the September data readout.

news.headline: Wells Fargo raises uniQure price target to $75 from $60, keeps Overweight/Buy
news.summary: Following Q2 results and the confirmed Q3 2026 BLA/UK MAA timeline, Wells Fargo lifted its 12-month target to $75, citing de-risked regulatory pathway and cash runway extension into 2030.

news.headline: Wolfe Research upgrades QURE to Outperform ($65 PT); shares volatile on Sept. data-delay concerns
news.summary: Wolfe upgraded uniQure from Peerperform, modeling ~70% probability of AMT-130 success, even as some shares gave back gains on reminders that pivotal four-year data (and thus BLA certainty) won't arrive until September, keeping the stock in a quiet-period lull.

news.headline: uniQure reports Q2 2026 results: BLA and UK MAA on track for Q3, $259M raise extends runway to 2030
news.summary: uniQure confirmed AMT-130's US BLA and UK MHRA MAA submissions remain on track for Q3 2026, with topline four-year data due in September; it also reported early positive signals from AMT-260 (epilepsy) and an AMT-191 (Fabry) update, ending the quarter with $810.3M in cash after a $259M offering (loss of $1.22/share, revenue up 11% to $5.8M, missing estimates).

news.headline: JPMorgan Chase discloses 7.0% passive stake in uniQure via Schedule 13G
news.summary: JPMorgan reported beneficial ownership of roughly 4.87 million shares (7%), adding to a run of large institutional 13G filings that underscore growing fund exposure to QURE ahead of key catalysts.

news.headline: Roche discontinues its Huntington's disease programs (including tominersen)
news.summary: Roche's decision to end its Huntington's disease pipeline removes a major rival approach to the disease, reinforcing uniQure's position as the most advanced Huntington's-modifying therapy in development.

catalysts.label: Four-year AMT-130 data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline four-year Phase I/II follow-up data (building on the 75% cUHDRS slowing at 3 years) confirmed by management as the key near-term catalyst; company is effectively in a quiet period until this releases.

catalysts.label: US BLA submission for AMT-130 (accelerated approval)
catalysts.detail: FDA and uniQure aligned (June 2026 Type B meeting) that 3-year data can serve as primary evidence; company reaffirmed Q3 2026 filing plan at Q2 2026 earnings (July 29). Not yet filed as of August 21.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA Marketing Authorisation Application (MAA)
catalysts.detail: Positive MHRA pre-submission meeting completed; filing based on 3-year Phase I/II data (75% slowing, p=0.003) planned for Q3 2026 as a parallel/second regulatory path.

catalysts.label: Confirmatory trial design & initiation
catalysts.detail: FDA and uniQure have shifted from a sham-surgery-controlled design to a randomized standard-of-care-controlled confirmatory study with total functional capacity at 36 months as primary endpoint; company aims to start it as expeditiously as possible, but no confirmed start date yet.

catalysts.label: Additional ex-US regulatory pathways
catalysts.detail: Management said it is pursuing further international regulatory routes for AMT-130 beyond the US/UK and would provide updates in H2 2026; no specifics disclosed yet.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA advisory committee (AdCom)
catalysts.detail: Earlier speculation about an AdCom review persists, but no confirmed date has surfaced since the FDA/uniQure alignment on the accelerated approval pathway; status remains unclear/unconfirmed.

catalysts.label: Possible accelerated approval decision for AMT-130; AMT-260/AMT-191 updates
catalysts.detail: Contingent on a clean September 2026 four-year readout and a successful Q3 2026 BLA filing/review. AMT-260 (refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy) showed early biological activity signals in its first cohort at the Q2 2026 update; AMT-191 (Fabry) showed durable enzyme activity gains through Feb 2026 with all dosed patients off ERT, with further updates expected.

pulse: uniQure remains in a largely quiet holding pattern as it awaits the pivotal September 2026 four-year AMT-130 data readout, with the stock trading near $47-48 on continued analyst upgrades (Wolfe, Wells Fargo) and heavy institutional accumulation (JPMorgan, RTW, Susquehanna all disclosing meaningful stakes through mid-August). Regulatory momentum is firmly positive: FDA and uniQure are aligned on a Q3 2026 accelerated-approval BLA using 3-year data plus a standard-of-care (not sham) confirmatory trial, a parallel UK MHRA filing is on track for the same quarter, and Roche's exit from Huntington's disease removes uniQure's most significant near-term rival. The company is well-funded (cash into 2030 after a $259M raise), leaving the September data readout and subsequent BLA/MAA review process as the dominant swing factors for the stock into 2027.
